subject: Application: D&AD New Blood Awards Mentorship Programme 2027

title.en: D&AD New Blood Awards 2027 Mentorship Programme
title.zh: D&AD New Blood Awards 2027 指導計畫

summary.en: A free online mentorship for university design students in Taiwan who want to take on a D&AD New Blood Awards 2027 brief. Weekly sessions run in Mandarin, with materials in English.
summary.zh: 為台灣熱愛設計的大學生與研究生而設的免費線上指導，陪你挑戰 D&AD New Blood Awards 2027 的競賽題目。每週線上會議以中文進行，搭配英文資料。

note.en: Free and run on a voluntary basis by HTU. This is an independent programme and is not organised by D&AD.
note.zh: 本計畫完全免費，由 HTU. 自發舉辦，並非 D&AD 官方活動。

text.en: Weekly feedback on your idea, process and craft, from first concept to final piece.
text.zh: 每週針對概念、過程與執行細節給予回饋，從發想一路到完稿。

text.en: Choosing a brief, reading what it really asks for, and presenting the work so it reads clearly.
text.zh: 挑選適合的題目、讀懂題目真正的要求，並讓作品的呈現清楚有力。

text.en: Turning the project into a strong portfolio piece, with advice on your wider portfolio.
text.zh: 把這次的作品整理成作品集的亮點，並給予整體作品集的建議。

eligibility.en: You are currently studying for a bachelor's or master's degree.
eligibility.zh: 目前就讀大學部或碩士班。

eligibility.en: You can join weekly online meetings from 15 December 2026, spend 1–2 hours a week on the project, and submit your entry before 11 March 2027.
eligibility.zh: 可以從 2026 年 12 月 15 日起每週參加線上會議，每週投入 1–2 小時，並在 2027 年 3 月 11 日前完成投件。

eligibility.en: You may apply as a team of two, as long as both members meet the criteria above.
eligibility.zh: 可兩人組隊報名，兩位成員都需符合上述資格。

text.en: Who you are and why you want to join. Include your email, school, programme and year.
text.zh: 你是誰、為什麼想參加。請附上 Email、學校、科系與年級。

text.en: Any format: a website, PDF or link.
text.zh: 格式不限：網站、PDF 或連結皆可。

text.en: First-round applications close, end of day
text.zh: 第一階段報名截止（當日 23:59）

text.en: Selected applicants receive further details. We will try to let every applicant know the result.
text.zh: 入選者將收到進一步資訊；我們會盡量通知每位申請者結果。
